style: naturalistic cinematic garage drama, cramped workspace, grease-stained hands and tools, warm tungsten mixed with cool daylight, shallow depth of field, restrained handheld intimacy
soundscape: Low garage room tone with an irregular engine tick, faint street hum beyond the corrugated walls, grit underfoot, and the small metallic ring of tools on a workbench.

subjects.description: An older mechanic with weathered features, close-cropped gray hair, a lean upright stance, and an oil-stained work shirt with rolled sleeves.
A younger mechanic with short dark hair, a compact build, grease-smudged blue coveralls, and a guarded, forward-leaning posture.
A used four-cylinder engine mounted in an open bay, its cast-metal surfaces dark with oil and its accessory belt visibly frayed at the edge.

speakers.description: The older mechanic, weathered and deliberate, speaking in a low, contained voice.
The younger mechanic, compact and guarded, speaking with a clipped, defensive edge.

description.text: The garage is cramped and dim, its back wall crowded with pegboard, coiled hoses, and a shelf of paint cans. A broad workbench runs along the left side, while the open engine bay occupies the center-right, its hood propped high.

Warm tungsten light from a caged bulb rakes across the men’s sleeves and the tools, while a cooler daylight rim comes through a high window and catches the belt’s frayed fibers. The older man’s pointing hand is sharp and contained; the younger man’s shoulders angle forward as their exchange tightens.
